SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 37.310945, -76.732349 (Approximated from street_address)
Report DescriptionTHE CALLER STATED THAT AN UNDERGROUND FLOW TANK AT AN OUTLET MALL CAUGHT FIRE DUE TO UNKNOWN REASONS. CURRENTLY THE FIRE IS IN DAY (2) OF BURNING WITH NO FORESEEABLE TIME FRAME ON WHEN IT WILL BE EXTINGUISHED. THIS INCIDENT IS OCCURRING OVER A (3) ACRE AREA AT THE LOCATION AND HAS CAUSED THE PARKING LOT BEHIND THE MALL TO COLLAPSE IN SOME AREAS. MATERIAL MADE OF POLYPROPYLENE AND PVC PIPING IN THE AREA IS BURNING IN LARGE AMOUNTS AND RELEASING THEIR FUMES INTO THE ATMOSPHERE. BECAUSE OF THIS AND THE DURATION OF THE FIRE THE CALLER IS CONCERNED ABOUT AIR QUALITY IN THE AREA. THE FLOW TANK HOLDS STORM WATER (RUNOFF FROM THE MALL) AND HAS A CAPACITY OF (1,000,000) GALLONS. THE AMOUNT IN THE TANK AT THE TIME OF THE EVENT IS UNKNOWN TO THE CALLER. THERE WAS NO REPORTED INJURIES, FATALITIES, OR EVACUATIONS DUE TO THIS INCIDENT.

ORIGINAL REPORT: ****THIS IS AN UPDATE TO NRC REPORT #1419329**** UPDATE IS AS FOLLOWS: - THE CALLER CONFIRMS (1) UNION PACIFIC EMPLOYEE IS A FATALITY, AND APPROXIMATELY (10) INJURIES TO PRIVATE CITIZENS (COMMERCE BUILDING). - THE CALLER UPDATES THE FREIGHT TRAIN STRUCK AN OCCUPIED TRACTOR TRAILER TRUCK AT THE GRADE CROSSING, WHICH RESULTED IN A DERAILMENT OF (AN UNKNOWN AMOUNT) OF RAIL CARS. THE DERAILED TRAIN STRUCK THE COMMERCE BUILDING. THERE WAS A RELEASE OF DIESEL FUEL (UNKNOWN AMOUNT) ONTO SOIL AND BALLAST. THERE WAS A RELEASE OF AN UNKNOWN AMOUNT OF DIESEL FUEL ONTO SOIL AND BALLAST. IT IS UNKNOWN IF ANY WATERWAYS OR STORM DRAINS WERE AFFECTED.
